title: Infinite monochromatic square-sum paths
plain: Colour the positive integers red and blue. Show there is always an infinite increasing sequence of one colour in which every two consecutive terms sum to a perfect square.
math: Prove every 2-colouring of $\mathbb{N}$ admits $a_1<a_2<\cdots$ of one colour with $a_i+a_{i+1}$ a perfect square for all $i$.
